description: Abstract class SqlBase for Drupal migrate source plugins, managing database connections, query preparation, batching, and requirements checks.

classes.name: SqlBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing core functionality for Drupal migration source plugins using SQL databases, including connection management, query building, batching, and requirement checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing configuration, plugin info, migration, and state service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependency injection for the state service.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the prepared query as a string when the object is used as a string.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the database connection based on configuration or state.

methods.name: setUpDatabase
methods.description: Sets up a database connection using provided configuration, adding connection info if necessary.

methods.name: checkRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the database connection requirements are met, throws exception if not.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Wrapper for database select queries with fetch mode set to associative array.

methods.name: prepareQuery
methods.description: Clones and tags the query, adding metadata for migration context.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Prepares and executes the query, handling batching and conditions for data fetching.

methods.name: fetchNextRow
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next row, fetching next batch if needed.

methods.name: fetchNextBatch
methods.description: Prepares the next batch of data by incrementing batch counter and resetting iterator.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets batch counter and iterator, preparing for re-fetching data.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to define the source SQL query.

methods.name: doCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of source records using countQuery.

methods.name: mapJoinable
methods.description: Determines if the source can join with the ID map table based on configuration and database compatibility.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares object for serialization, excluding the database connection.
